folders.name: network

folders.name: onion
folders.title: Dark Web (.onion)

folders.name: rfi

folders.intro: Remote File Inclusion parameter dorks — scripts including remote payloads.

folders.name: sensitive

folders.name: shodan
folders.title: Shodan
folders.intro: Shodan filter cheat-sheets and curated query collections for internet-device reconnaissance. Structured `.csv` files are installable data, not directly loadable queries.

folders.name: shopping
folders.title: E-commerce
folders.intro: Shop, marketplace and webstore parameter dorks — category and item pages.

folders.name: social
folders.title: Social Media
folders.intro: Social-platform dorks: Discord token exposure and LinkedIn people-intel queries.

folders.name: targets
folders.title: Recon Target Lists
folders.intro: Domain lists, not dork queries. Each `.csv` is a `domain,category` list meant to be fed into dorking tooling (e.g. SiteDorks-style workflows) or your own scripts — iterate a list and prepend `site:` to build scoped queries. Structured data: installable, but not query-loadable by AtDork's `--batch-file`.

folders.name: test
folders.title: Sample / Test
folders.intro: Sample packages used to demonstrate the package-manager reference syntax.

folders.name: virustotal
folders.title: VirusTotal Intelligence
folders.intro: VirusTotal Enterprise / Intelligence search queries for malware hunting — file, network and behaviour filters that map onto the VT search bar. These are engine queries, not Google dorks: load them with `atdork --database-dork @virustotal/... --database-preview` to preview, then paste into VirusTotal Intelligence.

folders.name: vuln
folders.title: Vulnerable Servers
folders.intro: Known-vulnerable server banners and administration consoles.

folders.name: yandex
folders.title: Yandex Dorks
folders.intro: Yandex-tuned dorks using Cyrillic keywords to surface leaked password pages.
